title: The Cat Who Paid For His Bread 🥖🐱

scenes.narration: Every morning, a skinny orange cat waited outside the old baker's shop.
scenes.image_prompt: a skinny orange tabby cat sitting outside a small old bakery at dawn, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: And every morning, the baker slipped him a warm piece of bread. He never told anyone.
scenes.image_prompt: an elderly baker with flour on his apron secretly handing bread to an orange tabby cat, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: Then one day, the cat showed up with something in his mouth. A shiny coin.
scenes.image_prompt: orange tabby cat dropping a gold coin at the baker's feet, baker surprised, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: The next day, another. And another. The baker followed him, to find out where they came from.
scenes.image_prompt: the old baker following an orange tabby cat through narrow cobblestone alleys, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: It led to a fountain, where tourists threw coins for luck. The cat was fishing them out. For him.
scenes.image_prompt: orange tabby cat reaching paw into a city fountain full of coins, tourists watching amazed, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: The baker didn't keep a single coin. He put them in a jar by the door, labeled, for whoever is hungry.
scenes.image_prompt: a glass jar of coins by a bakery door with a handwritten sign, orange tabby cat sitting proudly beside it, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur

scenes.narration: Kindness doesn't stay small. It just needs someone to start it.
scenes.image_prompt: the old baker and the orange tabby cat sharing bread on the bakery step at sunrise, Pixar-style 3D animation, cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16, highly detailed fur
